verdict.summary: The round-2 diff remains correct and narrowly scoped. The added negative self-test directly exercises the only distinguishing condition: an entry-level `retriage self-test ENV-BLOCKED` output has no `worker-live: ` prefix and therefore must remain a delivered refusal rather than a harness fault. The existing loop independently pins the prefixed harness-level ENV-BLOCKED case as a fault, so both sides are non-vacuously covered and a broadened bare `ENV-BLOCKED` marker would fail the new row. This preserves fail-closed grading and does not weaken any trust check, routing rule, workflow permission, SHA binding, or audit control.
